integrity: Analytic continuum proof with a standard-library finite diagnostic checker. No independent publication-priority audit or independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete mode classification for 0<=g/u<=2; beyond 2 only existence of >=3 modes for some admissible parameters. No full upper-mode bound or transient law for g>2u. Published stationary formula and one g=3u phase example are prior work.
title: A sharp two-to-one gradient threshold for stationary modes of a saturating run-and-tumble particle
